label: ❖ 파응다우 몽족 — 30대 워킹
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot.
Model: one woman in her thirties, curvy hourglass build, defined waist and broad hips, hair coiled high in a sculpted turban-style wrap.
Pose: mid-stride walking directly toward the camera, one leg crossing forward, torso squared and chest frontal, shoulders open, arms swinging naturally, chin level, looking into the lens.

Body fully painted with: Hmong paj ntaub reverse appliqué and cross-stitch — the entire body surface covered in tiny interlocking geometry with zero blank ground. Snail-shell spiral coils, elephant-foot squares, ram's-horn hooks and stepped maze frets, all outlined in crisp black and filled with magenta, chartreuse, turquoise, orange and white. Motifs sized small and repeated tightly so the pattern reads as continuous texture at full-body scale. Uniform density everywhere — no separate panels, no skirt or bodice shape.

Pigment applied directly on bare skin, matte, pores and skin texture visible.
The paint ends at the wrist and ankle in ONE thin crisp border; hands and feet bare.
Hands fully visible, five separated fingers each. Nails long coffin-shaped, lacquered bright turquoise with fine black outline.

Footwear: white patent platform stiletto sandals, 4cm platform, thick instep band, open toe with painted toenails visible.
Environment: a plain concrete courtyard, one paj ntaub panel hung out of focus behind.
Lighting: bright frontal-left key at 45 degrees, hard midday quality, crisp shadow under the jaw and bust, white wall bounce on the shadow side.
Style: high fashion editorial meeting textile craft. ultra-sharp 8K. portrait 2:3 vertical.
